semanticReview.method: Seguimiento R33 de fuente primaria gratuita: relectura del expediente anterior, cotejo de localizadores explícitos y alcance de cada afirmación; evidencia parcial no se extrapola.
findings: 이분/저분 se describen como demostrativos nominales honoríficos, con contraste espacial y flexión por partículas.

NIKL learner-dictionary entry directly supports 이분 as a highly deferential expression for 이 사람. No exact matching entry for 저분 was inspected in this pass. Referencias candidatas APA 7 con localizadores: National Institute of Korean Language. (n.d.). 이분 [Entry]. Korean-English Learners’ Dictionary. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=71152&nation=eng Locator: Headword 이분, definition as a highly deferential expression referring to 이 사람, examples and reference-word links; does not independently support 저분 or every spatial/pragmatic nuance.
limitations: Falta entrada lexicográfica exacta y evidencia de deixis cercana/distante en interacción; la equivalencia directa esta/aquella depende de centro deíctico y contexto.
Coverage is incomplete for 저분, the full near/far contrast, and context-dependent Spanish translations.
No se creó Evidence canónica ni se obtuvo assessEntry exitoso; el artículo no se modificó y no se declara VERIFIED.
